title: Economy & Markets Consolidation
goal: Combine formal cause connectors, compressed and mixed conditionals, reduplicated subjunctives and outcome periphrases in economic analysis.

items: I can explain economic causes, forecasts and past-to-present policy links in formal register.
I can express unconditional commitments and support-verb collocations in market commentary.
I can trace prolonged market outcomes and structural shifts with *acabar por*, *terminar por* and *pasar a*.
